title: Signed completed tensor shifts for arbitrary normalized reindexing data
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, and $g:X\xrightarrow\sim Y$ an isomorphism of schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible. Let $A,T$ be any completion and completed-tensor reindexing data satisfying all laws of [def-pod-completion-reindex-models] and [def-pod-completion-tensor-normalization], for the actual quotient-tower completed tensor. There exist signed tensor-shift data $S_Y,S_X$ whose strict homogeneous generators have first-factor sign 1 and second-factor sign $(-1)^{pr}$, and whose derived maps are the localizations of these shifts through the specified signed Roos models. They satisfy every clause of PodReindexSignedShifts of [def-pod-completion-reindex-shifts]: the reduction and limit natural transformations commute with canonical shifts; the limit shifts have the specified Roos models; and both tensor-factor shift squares commute with the same comparison T. All integers r, all good representatives and all derived presentation isomorphisms are included.

proof.text: Apply podReindexingTensorSignedShifts to the given A, hA, T and hT. Its completion and tensor data are arbitrary and its conclusion is exactly the required existence of SY and SX with all PodReindexSignedShifts laws. No specialization to the existential family of the completion-unit-tensor theorem is needed.

theorem podNormalized_tensor_signed_shifts
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (A : PodCompletionReindex l E g) (T : PodCompletedTensorReindex l E g A)
    (hA : PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E g A)
    (hT : PodCompletedTensorReindex.Laws l E g A T) :
    ∃ (SY : PodTensorSignedShift l E Y) (SX : PodTensorSignedShift l E X),
      PodReindexSignedShifts l E g A T SY SX
